Website chatbot development for business sites adds a chat window that answers visitor questions from your own pages, products and policies. Ecom Swift LLC sets it up on your site in your brand style and passes tricky questions to your team.

## What is a website chatbot?

A website chatbot is a chat window on your site that answers visitors' questions automatically. A good one draws its answers from your own pages, product information and policies, speaks in a tone that suits your brand and knows when to pass a conversation to a person.

It is different from a contact form, which waits for someone to write a message and then waits again for a reply. A chatbot answers while the visitor is still reading, which suits the moment when a question is fresh.

## Why visitors need answers on the page

Visitors ask small questions all the time: whether you deliver to their area, how a service works, what is included in a plan, when you are open. If the answer is not obvious, most people will not search your site or write an email. They will go to a competitor whose answer is easier to find.

Your team may already answer these by email or phone, but only during working hours. A chat window gives visitors a quick reply at any time and gives you a record of what people want to know. That record is valuable for improving the website itself.

## How a chatbot affects leads and workload

A chatbot helps in two directions. For visitors, it removes friction between a question and a decision. For your team, it absorbs the repeated questions and sends the real enquiries, with names and email addresses, to your inbox.

It also shows you the gaps. Questions that the bot cannot answer point to missing information on your site. Over time you can fix those pages and the bot together. The result depends on your traffic, your offer and the quality of your content, so we do not promise a number of leads.

## What a good website chatbot includes

- A chat window that matches your logo, colors and fonts.
- Answers drawn from your pages, files and policies.
- Hand-tuned replies to your most frequent questions.
- A friendly opening message that explains what it can help with.
- Name and email capture, with clear wording about use of the details.
- Handoff by email when a question needs a person.
- Rules for pages where the chat shows or stays hidden.
- A catalog connection, if you sell products.
- Event tracking in analytics, so you see how it is used.
- Clear limits: it says when it does not know and does not invent answers.
- A short guide for changing answers or switching it off.

## What we do

We start by reading the pages and documents the chatbot will use, and list the questions visitors ask most. We then add the chat window to your site and match it to your brand. Answers are built from your content, and we hand-tune the most important ones so they are accurate and in the right tone.

The Basic package adds a branded chat window that answers from your key pages and sends visitor questions to your email. The Standard package covers more pages and files, adds tuned FAQ answers, lead capture, handoff and testing on real questions. The Premium package covers a larger site, connects your product catalog, tracks chat events, sets where the chat appears and includes a tuning round after the first week.

We test before launch with real and awkward questions, including ones the bot should refuse. You then receive a short guide for editing answers and turning the chatbot off whenever you choose. Any running fees charged by the chatbot provider are paid by you directly, and we explain them before you decide.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Make sure your website pages are accurate before the bot learns them.
- Keep the opening message short and clear.
- Offer a path to a real person.
- Check the questions visitors ask during the first weeks.
- Hide the chat on pages where it distracts, such as checkout.

**Avoid:**
- Letting the bot cover topics your site never explains.
- Using a pop-up that opens on its own and blocks content.
- Collecting emails without saying why.
- Leaving outdated pages for the bot to quote.
- Launching without testing on mobile.

## Who this service is for

It suits a service business whose visitors have the same pre-booking questions every day. It suits a small shop that cannot answer messages round the clock. It also suits an agency that wants a ready-made chatbot for a client site.

## What we need from you

Your website address, a note of which pages matter most and any documents you want included. Tell us where visitor questions should be sent. We need access to your website platform as a collaborator, staff or developer user, so we can add the chat window. We never need passwords, and you can switch the chatbot off at any time.
